title: Good intentions, a spoiled result
literal_meaning: While shaping a deity, one made a monkey.
explanation: The intended improvement turns into a spoiled result. Good intentions alone do not guarantee that the work will turn out as planned.
meaning_odia: ସୁନ୍ଦର କିଛି ଗଢ଼ିବାକୁ ଲାଗିଥିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଫଳ ଇଚ୍ଛାମତେ ନହୋଇ ବିଗିଡ଼ିଗଲା। ଭଲ କରିବାର ଇଚ୍ଛା ଥିଲେ ବି କୌଶଳ ବା ଉପାୟ ଠିକ୍ ନହେଲେ ଏମିତି ହୋଇପାରେ। ଇଚ୍ଛା ଓ ଫଳର ଅମେଳକୁ କଥାଟି ଧରେ; କାମର ପଦ୍ଧତିକୁ ପୁଣି ଦେଖିବାର ଅବସର ବି ଦିଏ।
usage_example: An attempt to repair a small tear leaves a much larger hole. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source provides an explicit spoiled-work gloss and a synonymous expression. The image is not evidence of an actual sculptor or religious episode.
